blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — An 8-year-old boy with special needs died after being trapped inside their burning house in Purok 5, Barangay Nangka, Consolacion, shortly after midnight on Nov. 14, 2026. The victim’s mother revealed that the boy was sleeping alone in an adjacent room because his uncle, who usually sleeps beside him, had gone out the night before, November 13. The parents were sleeping in a separate room with their youngest child, 3, when they were startled to find flames already engulfing the victim’s room.
